lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to chisel out two new stone tablets, and Moses carries them up Mount Sinai early in the morning.
The LORD descends in a whirlwind and proclaims His name, calling Himself compassionate, gracious, and slow to anger.
Moses bows down and worships, then asks the Lord to go with them and take them as His inheritance.
The LORD promises to drive out the Amorites, and tells Israel to tear down the altars of the land and worship no other god.
Moses spends seven days and seven nights on the mountain, and when he comes down, his face is radiant.
